# apple_certificate (Data Source)

Looks up a certificate by its App Store Connect ID or serial number.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_certificate" "distribution" {
  serial_number = "5A3F0B2C9D8E7F61"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the certificate. Set this or `serial_number`.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number, in hexadecimal, in either case. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is activated.
- `certificate_content` (String, Sensitive) The certificate, base64-encoded DER.
- `certificate_type` (String) Certificate type.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the certificate.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the certificate, if it has one.
